name: beszel-agent
title: Beszel Agent
description: The agent side of Beszel: reports this host and its containers to a Beszel hub. In the hub click Add System, name it, use host.docker.internal (hub on this machine) or this host's IP with port 45876, copy the public key it shows into the field below, then deploy.

variables.name: BESZEL_AGENT_HUBKEY
variables.label: Hub public key
variables.description: The ssh-ed25519 public key shown by the hub when you add a system

variables.name: BESZEL_AGENT_PORT
variables.label: Agent port
variables.description: Port the hub connects to (host network)
